subject: general
question: Find the value of ((sec⁴A-sec²A))/((cot⁴A+cot²A))times ((cosec⁴A-cosec²A))/((tan²A+tan⁴A))+cot²A
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put **A = 45°** as it is the easiest value for **trigonometric identities** where **tan/cot** are involved.

sec 45° = √2, cosec 45° = √2, tan 45° = 1, cot 45° = 1.

Expression = [((√2)⁴ − (√2)²) ÷ (1⁴ + 1²)] × [((√2)⁴ − (√2)²) ÷ (1² + 1⁴)] + 1²

⇒ [(4 − 2) ÷ (1 + 1)] × [(4 − 2) ÷ (1 + 1)] + 1 = [2 ÷ 2] × [2 ÷ 2] + 1 = 1 × 1 + 1 = 2.

Check options for A = 45°: cosec²45° = (√2)² = 2.

**∴ The correct answer is cosec²A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ((sec⁴A-sec²A))/((cot⁴A+cot²A))times ((cosec⁴A-cosec²A))/((tan²A+tan⁴A))+cot²A 

**Formula Used:** sec²A − 1 = tan²A; cosec²A − 1 = cot²A; 1 + tan²A = sec²A; 1 + cot²A = cosec²A.

⇒ [sec²A(sec²A − 1) ÷ cot²A(1 + cot²A)] × [cosec²A(cosec²A − 1) ÷ tan²A(1 + tan²A)] + cot²A

⇒ [sec²A × tan²A ÷ (cot²A × cosec²A)] × [cosec²A × cot²A ÷ (tan²A × sec²A)] + cot²A

⇒ [ (sec²A × tan²A × cosec²A × cot²A) ÷ (cot²A × cosec²A × tan²A × sec²A) ] + cot²A

⇒ 1 + cot²A

⇒ cosec²A

**∴ The correct answer is cosec²A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Identities

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 | 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ | 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

tanθ × cotθ = 1 | sinθ × cosecθ = 1 | cosθ × secθ = 1.

Value Substitution Method

For identities, substituting standard angles like 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, or 90° often simplifies complex expressions, provided the denominator does not become zero.</p
